result.topic_en: Gauss works out auxiliary quantities and tables for the relation between the chord k, the radii sum r+r' and the time T (Lambert-type orbit problem), solving the cubic q = 2σ − (4/3)σ³ by the trigonometric substitution σ = √2·sin ψ with a short logarithmic computation table.
